title: Endaweni yakithi
description: Ten short stories about life in the neighbourhood: a street wedding with the indlamu and the umabo in Clermont, a polecat that scatters the rubbish at night in Phoenix, a puff adder under a grandmother's stool in Esikhawini, a New Year curry with crayfish at Muslim neighbours' in Overport, a grandmother's tale of a rogue, a San hunter and a cave of bats, a left-handed kickboxer at the community hall, Saturday Zulu lessons for a Russian doctor and a builder from Maputo, a kitchen fire put out by a poor stranger, geese that eat the snails in an old man's garden, and herd boys diving in a pool.

lessons.title: Umgcagco emgwaqweni wethu
lessons.summary: The whole street in Clermont comes to Ntombizanele's wedding to Ziphozenkosi Radebe: the young girls of the street dance the indlamu, the women admire the bride's purple dress and long eyelashes, food goes round on woven plates while people shout congratulations, and the next day at the umabo the new bride gives blankets to her husband's family, who now call her the wife of Radebe.
lessons.text:
NgoMgqibelo kukhona umgcagco emgwaqweni wethu eClermont. UNtombizanele ushada noZiphozenkosi Radebe. Bonke omakhelwane bayeza emgcagcweni, ngoba wonke umuntu emgwaqweni uyamazi uNtombizanele kusukela eyingane. Umgcagco wenziwa egcekeni elikhulu likamama wakhe.

Ekuseni amatshitshi omgwaqo ahlangana egcekeni. Lawa matshitshi azosina indlamu emgcagcweni. Itshitshi ngalinye ligqoke ubuhlalu obumhlophe nobumnyama. Itshitshi elincane kunawo onke lineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuphela, kodwa lisina kahle kakhulu. Amatshitshi asina indlamu kaningi ngaphambi komgcagco, ukuze angenzi amaphutha.

Emini uNtombizanele uyaphuma endlini. Ugqoke ingubo ende ensomi. Abesifazane bathi: "Bheka ingubo ensomi! Bheka nezinkophe zakhe!" UNtombizanele unezinkophe ezinde ezimnyama. Uma evala amehlo, izinkophe zakhe zithinta izihlathi zakhe. Ukhophe olulodwa luyawa, luhlale esihlathini sakhe. Umngane wakhe uyalubona, alukhiphe ngomunwe.

Abantu bashaya izandla, bathi: "Halala, Ntombizanele! Halala, Ziphozenkosi!" Amatshitshi asina indlamu ngaphambi kwabo. Aphakamisa umlenze phezulu, abuye awubeke phansi ngamandla. Lapho itshitshi elincane lisina indlamu yodwa, abantu baphinde bathi: "Halala, ntombazane! Halala!"

Ngemuva kokusina abesifazane baletha ukudla ezimbengeni. Imbenge ngayinye igcwele inyama, ilayisi nesinkwa. Izimbenge zihamba ezandleni zabantu, kuze kube yilapho wonke umuntu enokudla. Ekugcineni akusekho lutho ezimbengeni.

Ngakusasa kuba umabo emzini kaRadebe. Kumabo umlobokazi unika umndeni womyeni wakhe izipho. UNtombizanele ubeka izingubo zokulala phansi ngaphambi komndeni. Unika umama kaZiphozenkosi ingubo, anike nobaba wakhe ingubo. Unika nogogo kaZiphozenkosi ingubo. Abantu baphinde bathi: "Halala!" Umabo uphela ngemuva kwamahora amabili.

Ekupheleni komabo, umama kaZiphozenkosi uyasukuma. Uthi: "Lo mlobokazi uyasihlonipha. Kusukela namuhla uyindodakazi yami." Omakhelwane bayahleka bathi: "Bheka, umka Radebe!" UNtombizanele uyajabula. Manje ungumlobokazi, futhi wonke umuntu emgwaqweni umbiza ngokuthi umka Radebe.

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani ngoMgqibelo emgwaqweni?
Kukhona umgcagco kaNtombizanele noZiphozenkosi Radebe.
Amatshitshi omgwaqo enzani emgcagcweni?
Asina indlamu ngaphambi kwabantu.
UNtombizanele ugqoke ingubo enjani?
Ugqoke ingubo ende ensomi.
Abesifazane baletha ukudla ngani?
Baletha ukudla ezimbengeni.
Kumabo umlobokazi wenzani?
Unika umndeni womyeni wakhe izipho, njengezingubo zokulala.
Ekugcineni omakhelwane bathi uNtombizanele ungubani?
Bathi ungumka Radebe.

lessons.title: Ubani ogqagqa udoti?
lessons.summary: In Phoenix, something scatters Nonkanyiso's rubbish every night: her old neighbour Mdluli grumbles and blames her cat, she grows fed up with picking up papers and dog dung with tongs, and one night she sees a polecat at the rubbish pile; it makes a terrible smell, Mdluli says sorry, and she buys bins with lids and a wastebasket for the kitchen.
lessons.text:
UNonkanyiso uhlala ePhoenix, endlini encane eduze komgwaqo. Ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe kunezala elincane, lapho ebeka khona izikhwama zakhe zikadoti. NgoLwesihlanu ekuseni iloli likadoti liyafika, lithathe izala lonke.

Ngolunye usuku uNonkanyiso uvuka ekuseni, abone ukuthi izala alisekho ndawonye. Izikhwama zidabukile, futhi into ethile igqagqe udoti emgwaqweni wonke. Amaphepha, amabhodlela namathambo kugqagqeke phansi. UNonkanyiso ubheka izikhwama leziya ezidabukile eceleni komgwaqo, abuze: "Ngubani owenze lokhu?"

Umakhelwane wakhe, uMdluli, uphuma endlini yakhe. UMdluli yindoda endala, futhi uthanda ukugwavuma. Uyagwavuma: "Ingobe yakho iyagqagqa udoti wakho ebusuku! Bheka! Udoti ufika ngisho nasegcekeni lami!" UNonkanyiso unengobe empunga. Uthi: "Cha, Baba, ingobe yami ilala endlini ebusuku." Kodwa uMdluli uyaqhubeka uyagwavuma.

UNonkanyiso uthatha udlawu. Uqoqa amaphepha namathambo ngodlawu, ngoba akafuni ukuwathinta ngezandla. Ubuye abone isimba senja eceleni komgwaqo. Uthi: "Nalesi simba!" Usithatha ngodlawu, asiphonse esikhwameni. Inja yomunye umakhelwane ihlala ishiya isimba lapha.

Ngobusuku obulandelayo kwenzeka okufanayo, nangobusuku besithathu futhi. Njalo ekuseni uNonkanyiso uqoqa udoti ngodlawu, uMdluli agwavume. Ekugcineni uNonkanyiso uyacikeka. Uthi: "Ngicikekile manje! Ngizobona ukuthi ngubani ogqagqa udoti wami."

NgoLwesine ebusuku uNonkanyiso akalali. Uhlala eduze komnyango, ingobe yakhe ilele emilenzeni yakhe. Phakathi kwamabili uzwa umsindo ngaphandle. Ubona isilwane esincane esimnyama. Emhlane waso kunombala omhlophe. Asiyona ingobe, futhi asiyona inja. Yiqaqa! Iqaqa livula izikhwama ngezinzipho zalo, ligqagqe udoti, lifune ukudla.

UNonkanyiso uvula umnyango, athi: "Hamba!" Iqaqa liyethuka, bese likhipha umoya onuka kabi kakhulu. Iqaqa libaleke, kodwa umoya omubi usala emgwaqweni wonke. UMdluli uvula umnyango wakhe, akhwehlele.

Ekuseni uNonkanyiso ukhombisa uMdluli izinyawo emhlabathini. Uthi: "Uyazibona leziya zinyawo ezincane? Yizinyawo zeqaqa. Akuyona ingobe yami, Baba." UMdluli uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, ntombi yami. Nami ngizwile umsindo ebusuku, futhi ngizwile umoya omubi. Ngeke ngiphinde ngigwavume ngengobe yakho."

Ngalolo suku uNonkanyiso uthenga imigqomo emibili enezivalo eziqinile. Uthenga nesihlelo esincane sasekhishini. Manje ubeka amaphepha esihlelweni, bese ewafaka emgqomweni. Manje iqaqa alikwazi ukugqagqa udoti, futhi uMdluli akasagwavumi.

Imibuzo:
UNonkanyiso ubonani ekuseni?
Ubona ukuthi into ethile igqagqe udoti emgwaqweni.
UMdluli uthi ngubani ogqagqa udoti?
Uthi yingobe kaNonkanyiso.
UNonkanyiso uqoqa udoti ngani?
Uqoqa udoti ngodlawu.
Kungani uNonkanyiso engalali ngoLwesine?
Ngoba ucikekile, futhi ufuna ukubona ukuthi ngubani ogqagqa udoti.
Ngubani ogqagqa udoti ngempela?
Yiqaqa.
UNonkanyiso uthengani ekugcineni?
Uthenga imigqomo enezivalo nesihlelo sasekhishini.

lessons.title: Inyoka ngaphansi kwesigqiki
lessons.summary: In Esikhawini, Zamambo finds a puff adder under her grandmother's stool by the yard wall; her older brother Mbusiso runs away and she teases him about his cowardice, she whispers to her grandmother not to move, and the snake catcher Bhengu comes with a haversack and a box, catches the puff adder and a small horned adder by the wall, and explains why people must not kill them.
lessons.text:
UZamambo uneminyaka eyishumi. Uhlala eSikhawini nogogo wakhe nobhuti wakhe omdala, uMbusiso. Egcekeni labo kukhona ubonda oluphansi lwamatshe, futhi eduze nobonda kukhona isigqiki sikagogo. Njalo kusihlwa ugogo uhlala esigqikini sakhe eduze nobonda, abheke abantu abadlula emgwaqweni.

NgoMgqibelo kusihlwa uZamambo uphuma ayolanda ugogo, ngoba ukudla sekulungile. Ugogo uhlezi esigqikini, ulele kancane. UZamambo ubheka phansi, abone into ende ngaphansi kwesigqiki. Into leyo inombala onsundu nomhlophe. Yinyoka! Yibululu!

UZamambo uyazi ukuthi ibululu linobuthi obubi kakhulu. Uyazi nokuthi ibululu alibaleki njengezinye izinyoka. Lilala phansi lithule, kuze kube yilapho umuntu efika eduze kwalo.

UMbusiso uphuma endlini. UZamambo uthi kuye: "Mbusiso, kukhona ibululu ngaphansi kwesigqiki sikagogo!" UMbusiso uyalibona ibululu, bese ebaleka. Ubaleka angene endlini, avale umnyango. UZamambo uthi: "Lobu ngubugwala, Mbusiso! Ugogo usesigqikini!"

UZamambo akabaleki. Usondela kancane kugogo. Uyanyenyeza endlebeni yakhe: "Gogo, ungavuki. Ungahambi. Kukhona ibululu ngaphansi kwesigqiki." Ugogo uvula amehlo. Naye uyanyenyeza: "Ngiyezwa, ntombi yami. Ngeke nginyakaze." Bese uZamambo enyenyeza futhi: "Ngizoshayela umuntu obamba izinyoka."

UBhengu ubamba izinyoka endaweni yonke. Ufika ngemuva kwemizuzu eyishumi. Ufika nobhaka emhlane, futhi uphethe ikesi elimnyama ngesandla. Obhakeni lwakhe kukhona induku ende namagilavu aqinile. UBhengu ukhipha induku obhakeni, agqoke amagilavu.

UBhengu ubamba ibululu ngenduku, alibeke ekesini. Uvala ikesi ngokushesha. Ugogo uyasukuma esigqikini, ahambe kancane aye endlini. UZamambo uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Baba Bhengu!"

Kodwa uBhengu ubheka ubonda. Uthi: "Bheka ukunyakaza lokhuya ngasobondeni!" UZamambo ubheka ukunyakaza lokhuya, kodwa akaboni lutho. UBhengu usondela kancane. Ngaphansi kwetshe kukhona inyoka encane enezimpondo ezincane ekhanda. Yindlondlo. UBhengu uthi: "Indlondlo nayo inobuthi. Kodwa le ndlondlo incane kakhulu." Uyibamba ngenduku, ayibeke ekesini.

UMbusiso uphuma endlini, ahlale kude nekesi. UBhengu uthi: "Ningazibulali izinyoka. Ibululu nendlondlo zidla amagundane. Ngizozihambisa ehlathini." Ubeka ikesi emotweni yakhe, afake nobhaka. UMbusiso uthi kuZamambo: "Ngiyaxolisa ngobugwala bami namuhla. Wena unesibindi."

Imibuzo:
Ugogo uhlala kuphi njalo kusihlwa?
Uhlala esigqikini sakhe eduze nobonda.
UZamambo ubonani ngaphansi kwesigqiki?
Ubona ibululu.
UMbusiso wenzani lapho ebona ibululu?
Ubaleka angene endlini, avale umnyango.
UZamambo wenzani endlebeni kagogo?
Uyanyenyeza, athi ugogo angavuki futhi angahambi.
UBhengu ufika nani?
Ufika nobhaka emhlane nekesi elimnyama.
UBhengu ubona yiphi inyoka ngasobondeni?
Ubona indlondlo encane.

lessons.title: Ukhali losuku loncibijane
lessons.summary: On New Year's Day in Overport, Lusanda's Muslim neighbours Fatima and Yusuf invite her to cook a curry with crayfish: Fatima shows her how sharp her knife is, Lusanda chops potatoes and pumpkin and mixes the curry powder with salt, Yusuf explains that Muslims drink no alcohol and pours sweet grape juice instead, and the meal satisfies everyone so much that Lusanda asks to learn the curry for the next New Year.
lessons.text:
ULusanda uhlala eOverport eThekwini. Omakhelwane bakhe ngoFatima nomyeni wakhe uYusuf. UFatima noYusuf bangamasulumani. Njalo ngoLwesihlanu uYusuf uyakhuleka namanye amasulumani, futhi umndeni wabo awudli ingulube. UFatima uthanda ukupheka ukudla okumnandi, futhi uthanda ukupha omakhelwane bakhe.

Kusasa kuyilanga loncibijane. Abantu abaningi emgwaqweni bayaphuza, bayadansa, futhi bayashisa izinto ezikhanyayo ebusuku. UFatima uthi kuLusanda: "Ngoncibijane ngizopheka ukhali. Woza uzongisiza." ULusanda uthi: "Ngiyabonga! Ngithanda ukhali kakhulu, kodwa angazi ukupheka ukhali."

Ngakusasa ekuseni ngoncibijane uLusanda uya endlini kaFatima. Etafuleni kunezikhuphashe ezinkulu ezimbili. UYusuf uzithenge olwandle izolo. UFatima uthi: "Namuhla sizopheka ukhali ngalezi zikhuphashe."

UFatima unika uLusanda ummese. Uthi: "Bona ubukhali balo mmese." Usika iphepha ngommese, iphepha lihlukane kalula. ULusanda uthi: "Hhayi! Ubukhali balo mmese bukhulu kakhulu!" UFatima uthi: "Canda amazambane kancane, ngoba ubukhali bawo bukhulu."

ULusanda ucanda amazambane. Ucanda nethanga, acande notamatisi. UFatima ubeka imbiza esitofini, afake amafutha embizeni. Bese enika uLusanda impuphu yokhali nosawoti. Uthi: "Dibanisa impuphu nosawoti, bese ufaka embizeni." ULusanda udibanisa impuphu nosawoti, bese ekudibanisa namazambane notamatisi embizeni. Indlu yonke inuka kamnandi. Ekugcineni uFatima ufaka izikhuphashe embizeni.

Emini bonke bahlala etafuleni. UYusuf uletha ibhodlela elikhulu lojusi wamagilebhisi. Uthi: "Thina masulumani asiphuzi utshwala. Ngoncibijane siphuza ujusi." Uthela ujusi ezitsheni ezincane. ULusanda uphuza ujusi. Uthi: "Lo jusi omtoti umnandi kakhulu!" UYusuf uthi: "Amagilebhisi amtoti enza ujusi omtoti."

Ukhali ushisa kakhulu, kodwa umnandi. ULusanda udla kancane, aphuze ujusi omtoti phakathi. Udla isitsha sokuqala, bese edla nesesibili. Ekugcineni uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Fatima. Ukudla kwakho kungidelisile ngempela. Angizange ngidle ukhali omnandi kanje." UFatima uyajabula. Uthi: "Uma ukudla kwami kudelisa umakhelwane wami, nami ngiyajabula."

ULusanda uthi: "Ngoncibijane olandelayo ngifuna ukupheka ukhali nawe futhi, ngifunde konke." UYusuf uthi: "Siyavuma. Kodwa ngoncibijane olandelayo, wena uzoletha ujusi!"

Imibuzo:
UFatima noYusuf bangobani?
Bangomakhelwane bakaLusanda, futhi bangamasulumani.
UFatima upheka ukudla okunjani ngoncibijane?
Upheka ukhali nezikhuphashe.
UFatima ukhombisa uLusanda kanjani ubukhali bommese?
Usika iphepha ngommese, iphepha lihlukane kalula.
ULusanda udibanisani?
Udibanisa impuphu yokhali nosawoti, bese ekudibanisa namazambane notamatisi.
Kungani uYusuf eletha ujusi?
Ngoba amasulumani awaphuzi utshwala.
ULusanda uthini ngemuva kokudla?
Uthi ukudla kukaFatima kumdelisile ngempela.

lessons.title: Inganeko kaGogo Nyawose
lessons.summary: On a cold night in Maphephethe, while snow falls on the far mountains, Gogo Nyawose tells the neighbours' children Zizipho and Kwenzokuhle a tale: a rogue steals a duiker from a San hunter and hides in a cave full of bats as the snow falls, a crow leads the hunter to the cave, and at the bottom of the cave the rogue fears the goblin that people say lives there, runs out and leaves the duiker behind.
lessons.text:
NgoNtulikazi kuyabanda kakhulu eMaphephethe. Kuthiwa kuyakhithika ezintabeni zeDrakensberg. Ebusuku izingane zomakhelwane, uZizipho noKwenzokuhle, ziya endlini kaGogo Nyawose. Ugogo ubasa umlilo, bese bonke behlala eduze nomlilo. UZizipho uthi: "Gogo, sixoxele inganeko!" UGogo Nyawose uyahleka athi: "Kulungile. Ngizonixoxela inganeko yakudala kakhulu."

"Kudala kakhulu, ezintabeni ezinkulu, kwakuhlala umuthwa. Abathwa babengabazingeli abahle kakhulu. Ngelinye ilanga umuthwa lowo wazingela, wabulala impunzi ngomkhonto wakhe. Impunzi yayincane, kodwa yayinenyama emnandi. Umuthwa wayeyithwala ehlombe lakhe, ebuyela ekhaya.

"Umuthwa wayekhathele, walala phansi kwesihlahla. Kwakukhona ishinga elalibheka umuthwa. Lelo shinga lalingathandi ukuzingela. Lalithanda ukuntshontsha izinto zabanye abantu. Lapho umuthwa elele, ishinga lathatha impunzi, labaleka nayo.

"Ngaleso sikhathi kwaqala ukukhithika. Iqhwa elimhlophe lawa phezu kwezintaba. Ishinga lalibanda, ngakho lafuna indawo yokuzifihla. Labona umgede omkhulu, langena kuwo nempunzi. Emgedeni kwakumnyama, futhi kwakukhona amalulwane amaningi. Amalulwane ayelenga ophahleni lomgede.

"Igwababa elimnyama lalibonile ishinga. Igwababa landiza laya kumuthwa, lakhala kakhulu phezulu kwakhe. Umuthwa wavuka, wabona ukuthi impunzi yakhe ayisekho. Walandela igwababa, wafika emgedeni.

"Ngaphakathi emgedeni ishinga lahamba laya ebuphansini bomgede, ukuze lingabonwa. Kodwa abantu bakhona babethi umkhovu uhlala ebuphansini balowo mgede. Umkhovu mncane, kodwa unamandla amabi. Ishinga lalikwazi lokho, futhi lalesaba kakhulu.

"Lapho umuthwa engena emgedeni, amalulwane athuka, andiza ngamandla. Ishinga lezwa umsindo omkhulu ebumnyameni. Lathi: 'Umkhovu uyeza!' Ishinga lagijima laphuma emgedeni, lashiya impunzi phansi. Labaleka eqhweni, futhi alizange libuye.

"Umuthwa wathola impunzi yakhe ebuphansini bomgede. Wanika igwababa inyama encane, ngoba lalimsizile. Bese ebuyela ekhaya nempunzi yakhe."

UGogo Nyawose uthi: "Inganeko yami iphelile." UKwenzokuhle uyahleka athi: "Ishinga lalesaba umkhovu, kodwa kwakungamalulwane nje!" Ugogo uthi: "Kunjalo. Ishinga linobugwala, futhi umuntu ontshontshayo uhlala esaba." Ngaphandle kuyabanda, kodwa izingane zifudumele eduze nomlilo.

Imibuzo:
Kuthiwa kwenzekani ezintabeni zeDrakensberg?
Kuthiwa kuyakhithika ezintabeni.
Umuthwa wabulala siphi isilwane?
Wabulala impunzi ngomkhonto.
Ishinga lenzani lapho umuthwa elele?
Lathatha impunzi, labaleka nayo.
Ishinga lazifihla kuphi?
Lazifihla emgedeni omkhulu, lahamba laya ebuphansini bawo.
Ngubani owasiza umuthwa?
Igwababa elimnyama lamsiza, futhi umuthwa walandela igwababa emgedeni.
Kungani ishinga laphuma emgedeni ngokushesha?
Ngoba lalesaba ukuthi umkhovu uyeza, kodwa kwakungamalulwane.

lessons.title: Inqindi lesinxele
lessons.summary: At the community hall in Chesterville, left-handed Nhlakaniphile starts kickboxing with coach Dladla: she eats a big meal before her first session and vomits, so she learns to train on an empty stomach; she kicks the heavy bag until her hip hurts and the coach massages it with oil; he teaches her that a well-trained fighter keeps calm, and at the neighbourhood contest she wins with a punch of her left fist.
lessons.text:
UNhlakaniphile uneminyaka eyishumi nesikhombisa. Uhlala eChesterville, futhi uyinxele. Ubhala ngesinxele, udla ngesinxele, futhi uphonsa ibhola ngesinxele. Ehholo lomphakathi endaweni yabo kukhona iqembu labantu abafunda ukulwa ngezandla nangezinyawo. Umqeqeshi weqembu nguDladla. UNhlakaniphile ufuna ukujoyina iqembu.

NgoMsombuluko uNhlakaniphile ufika ehholo okokuqala. Ngaphambi kokufika udle isitsha esikhulu selayisi nenyama. UDladla uthi: "Namuhla sizogijima, bese sikhaba isikhwama esikhulu." Bagijima imizuzu eyishumi. Bese uNhlakaniphile ekhaba isikhwama, asikhabe futhi, asikhabe kaningi. Ngokushesha isisu sakhe siba buhlungu. Ugijimela emnyango, agabhe ngaphandle. Ugabha ilayisi lonke alidlile.

UNhlakaniphile uyaphoxeka. UDladla ubona ubuhlanzo phansi ngaphandle. UNhlakaniphile ugeza ubuhlanzo bakhe ngamanzi. UDladla uthi: "Ungaphoxeki. Abantu abaningi bayagabha ngosuku lokuqala. Kodwa ungadli kakhulu ngaphambi kokuqeqeshwa. Uma isisu sigcwele, uzogabha futhi." Kusukela ngalolo suku uNhlakaniphile udla kancane ngaphambi kokuqeqeshwa, futhi akaphindi agabhe.

UDladla ubona ukuthi uNhlakaniphile uyinxele. Uthi: "Iningi labantu lilwa ngesandla sokudla. Abaningi abazi ukulwa nenxele. Ngeke balilindele inqindi lesinxele lakho." UNhlakaniphile ufunda ukushaya ngenqindi lesinxele. Ushaya isikhwama ngenqindi, asishaye futhi, kuze kube yilapho inqindi lakhe liba buhlungu.

Ngesonto lesithathu uNhlakaniphile ukhaba isikhwama kakhulu. Ngobunye ubusuku inqulu yakhe iba buhlungu. Akakwazi ukuhamba kahle. UDladla uthatha amafutha, abeke isandla enqulwini yakhe. Uthi: "Ukuhlikihla kuzokusiza." Ukuhlikihla kwakhe kuthatha imizuzu eyishumi. Ngakusasa inqulu yakhe ingcono.

UDladla uyaqhubeka nokufundisa: "Umdlali oqeqeshekile uyazi ukuthula. Abadlali abangaqeqeshekile bayathukuthela, bese bekhaba noma kuphi. Kodwa umdlali oqeqeshekile ubheka, alinde, bese eshaya ngesikhathi esifanele." UNhlakaniphile uyaqeqesheka isikhathi eside. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu useqeqesheke kahle.

NgoMgqibelo kukhona umncintiswano ehholo. UNhlakaniphile ulwa nentombazane ende evela kwenye indawo. Intombazane iyamkhaba, kodwa uNhlakaniphile uthula. Ubheka, alinde. Ekugcineni ushaya ngenqindi lesinxele. Intombazane ayilindele lokho. Iyawa, futhi uNhlakaniphile uyanqoba. UDladla uthi: "Uyinxele elihle kakhulu!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNhlakaniphile ebhala ngesinxele?
Ngoba uyinxele.
Kwenzekani ngosuku lokuqala ehholo?
UNhlakaniphile ukhaba isikhwama, bese egabha ngaphandle.
Kungani egabha?
Ngoba wadla isitsha esikhulu selayisi nenyama ngaphambi kokuqeqeshwa.
Yini ebuhlungu ngesonto lesithathu?
Inqulu yakhe ibuhlungu.
UDladla umsiza kanjani?
Umsiza ngokuhlikihla inqulu yakhe ngamafutha.
UNhlakaniphile unqoba kanjani emncintiswaneni?
Ushaya intombazane ngenqindi lesinxele.

lessons.title: Isifundo sesiZulu
lessons.summary: At a school in Sundumbili, Nomakhosi Mbele teaches Zulu on Saturdays to two newcomers: Natasha, a Russian doctor at the clinic, and Joaquim, a short builder from Maputo who speaks Portuguese; Joaquim cannot see the board clearly from the back and moves forward, Nomakhosi explains the diminutive, Natasha gathers knowledge from Zulu books, Joaquim's absence one week is made up with a written summary, and a Zulu song stirs up their love for the language.
lessons.text:
UNomakhosi Mbele ufundisa esikoleni samabanga aphansi eSundumbili. NgoMgqibelo ekuseni ufundisa isiZulu kubantu abadala esikoleni. Abafundi bakhe ababili bafika endaweni kulo nyaka. UNatasha ungudokotela esibhedlela. Uvela eMoscow, futhi ukhuluma isiRashiya. UJoaquim wakha izindlu. Uvela eMaputo, futhi ukhuluma isiPutukezi. Bobabili bafuna ukukhuluma nomakhelwane babo ngesiZulu.

UNatasha mude, kodwa uJoaquim mfisha. Ngosuku lokuqala uJoaquim uhlala emuva. UNomakhosi ubhala ebhodini, kodwa uJoaquim uthi: "Angibonisisi. Ngimfisha, futhi ikhanda lomuntu ohlezi ngaphambi kwami liyangivimba." UNomakhosi uthi: "Woza ngaphambili." UJoaquim uhlala phambili. Uthi: "Manje ngiyabonisisa yonke into."

UNomakhosi ufundisa ngesinciphiso. Uthi: "Isinciphiso sisitshela ukuthi into incane. Uma ufuna isinciphiso, ushintsha ukuphela kwegama." Ubhala ebhodini: "Indlu, indlwana. Umfana, umfanyana." UNatasha uthi: "NgesiRashiya nathi sinesinciphiso." UJoaquim uthi: "NesiPutukezi sinesinciphiso." Bonke bayahleka, ngoba izilimi eziningi zinesinciphiso.

UNatasha uthanda ukufunda. Ngemuva kwesifundo uhlala esikoleni, afunde izincwadi zesiZulu. UNomakhosi uthi: "Uyazitapela ulwazi ezincwadini, Natasha. Lokho kuhle." Ngamasonto onke uNatasha uzitapela ulwazi olusha.

NgoMgqibelo wesithathu uJoaquim akezi. Kufanele asebenze endlini entsha eMandeni. Ukuphutha kwakhe kudabukisa uNomakhosi, ngoba isifundo salolo suku sisha futhi sinzima. Ngakho ubhala isifingqo sesifundo ephepheni. Isifingqo sifushane: sinemisho eyishumi kuphela. NgoMgqibelo olandelayo unika uJoaquim isifingqo. UJoaquim ufunda isifingqo, athi: "Ngiyabonga. Ngenxa yesifingqo sakho, ukuphutha kwami akuzange kungilimaze."

Ngelinye ilanga uNatasha uvula incwadi ekhasini elingalungile ngokuphutha. Ufunda umusho ongaziwa, bese ebuza uNomakhosi. UNomakhosi uthi: "Uyabuza kahle. IsiZulu sakho sihlana manje. Asisihle kakhulu okwamanje, kodwa sihlana." UNatasha uyajabula.

Ekugcineni kwesifundo uNomakhosi uculela abafundi ingoma yesiZulu endala. Ingoma iqhanyela uthando lwabo lolimi. UJoaquim uthi: "Le ngoma iqhanyela inhliziyo yami. Ngifuna ukufunda kakhulu." UNatasha uthi: "Nami. NgoMgqibelo ozayo ngizofika ngesikhathi."

Imibuzo:
UNatasha noJoaquim bakhuluma ziphi izilimi?
UNatasha ukhuluma isiRashiya, uJoaquim ukhuluma isiPutukezi.
Kungani uJoaquim engabonisisi ebhodini?
Ngoba umfisha, futhi uhlala emuva ngemuva komuntu.
UNomakhosi ufundisa ngani?
Ufundisa ngesinciphiso, njengokuthi indlu nendlwana.
UNatasha wenzani ngemuva kwesifundo?
Uzitapela ulwazi ezincwadini zesiZulu.
UNomakhosi wenzani ngenxa yokuphutha kukaJoaquim?
Ubhala isifingqo sesifundo ephepheni, asinike uJoaquim.
Ingoma endala yenzani?
Iqhanyela uthando lwabo lolimi.

lessons.title: Umlilo ekhishini
lessons.summary: In Sobantu, Ntethelelo is frying fish for her family when a poor stranger, Mvelase, comes to the gate to beg for bread; while she answers the phone the seething oil blazes up, Mvelase runs in, covers the pot with a wet cloth and stamps out the burning cloth on the floor, the smoke has blackened the wall, and the family shares the meal with him while her husband offers him work and a better future.
lessons.text:
UNtethelelo uhlala eSobantu nomyeni wakhe nezingane zabo ezintathu. Usapho lwakhe luthanda inhlanzi kakhulu. NgoLwesihlanu kusihlwa uNtethelelo upheka inhlanzi ekhishini. Ubeka imbiza esitofini, athele amafutha amaningi embizeni. Amafutha ayashisa, aze axhaphe. Uma amafutha exhapha, uNtethelelo ufaka inhlanzi.

Ngaleso sikhathi kukhona indoda ngaphandle kwendlu. Indoda igqoke izingubo ezindala, futhi izicathulo zayo zidabukile. Ithi: "Ngiyakubingelela, Mama. Ngicela ungiphe isinkwa. Angidlanga izolo nanamuhla." UNtethelelo uyabona ukuthi indoda iyanxiba ngoba ilambile ngempela. Uyabuza: "Ungubani wena?" Indoda ithi: "NginguMvelase. Ngingumfokazana nje. Angazi muntu lapha, futhi akekho ongazi."

UNtethelelo uthi: "Linda kancane, Mvelase. Ngizokuphathela ukudla." Ngaleso sikhathi ucingo lwakhe lukhala egumbini lokulala. Uyahamba ayophendula ucingo, ashiye imbiza esitofini. Amafutha ayaqhubeka exhapha embizeni.

Ngemuva kwemizuzu emibili kugqamuka umlilo embizeni. Umlilo ugqamuka uye phezulu, uthinte indwangu eceleni kwesitofu. Indwangu nayo iyasha, bese iwa phansi. UMvelase ubona umlilo ugqamuka ngomnyango. Akanxibi futhi. Ugijima angene ekhishini.

UMvelase uthatha enye indwangu, ayifake emanzini. Ubeka indwangu emanzi phezu kwembiza. Umlilo wembiza uyacima. Bese egxiviza indwangu evuthayo phansi ngezicathulo zakhe. Uyagxiviza, agxivize futhi, kuze kube yilapho umlilo ucima. UNtethelelo ubuya egijima. Ubona umjuluko ebusweni bukaMvelase, ubona nentuthu ekhishini.

Udonga oluseduze nesitofu lumnyama manje. Intuthu ishunqise udonga, futhi ishunqise nophahla. UMvelase usula umjuluko ebusweni bakhe. Uthi: "Ungafaki amanzi emafutheni avuthayo. Kungcono ukumboza ngendwangu emanzi."

Umyeni kaNtethelelo uyafika. Ubona udonga olushunqisiwe, bese ezwa yonke indaba. Uthi: "Mvelase, usindise usapho lwami. Awusiye umfokazana kithi. Hlala, udle nathi." Usapho lonke luhlala etafuleni, ludle inhlanzi noMvelase.

Umyeni kaNtethelelo usebenza endaweni yokulungisa izimoto. Uthi: "Ngidinga umuntu ozongisiza. Woza ngoMsombuluko." UMvelase uyajabula kakhulu. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga. Izolo ikusasa lami lalimnyama. Namuhla ikusasa lami likhanya."

Imibuzo:
UNtethelelo upheka nini inhlanzi?
Upheka inhlanzi ngoLwesihlanu kusihlwa.
UMvelase wenzani ngaphandle kwendlu?
Unxiba isinkwa ngoba ulambile.
Kwenzekani lapho uNtethelelo ephendula ucingo?
Kugqamuka umlilo embizeni, bese indwangu iwa phansi ivutha.
UMvelase ucisha kanjani umlilo?
Ubeka indwangu emanzi phezu kwembiza, bese egxiviza indwangu evuthayo phansi.
Intuthu yenzani odongeni?
Intuthu ishunqise udonga nophahla.
Ekugcineni uMvelase uthi ikusasa lakhe linjani?
Uthi ikusasa lakhe likhanya namuhla.

lessons.title: Amahansi kaMkhulu Msweli
lessons.summary: After the rains in Verulam, the damp ground fills old Msweli's vegetable garden with snails and beetles that eat his cabbages; his granddaughter Khwezilomso suggests geese, they buy a goose with four goslings that eat the snails and beetles, the goose punctures Khwezilomso's new ball with its beak, frogs in the little pond eat insects at night, and the cabbages grow big again.
lessons.text:
UMkhulu Msweli uhlala eVerulam. Unesivande esikhulu ngemuva kwendlu yakhe, lapho etshala khona amaklabishi, otamatisi nobhontshisi. Umzukulu wakhe, uKhwezilomso, uneminyaka eyishumi, futhi umsiza esivandeni njalo ngeSonto.

NgoMashi kunetha kakhulu izinsuku eziningi. Ngemuva kwemvula umhlabathi ugcwele ubumanzi. Ubumanzi buhle ezitshalweni, kodwa buletha nezinkinga. Ekuseni uMkhulu Msweli uthola iminenke emaklabishini akhe. Umnenke ngamunye udla amaklabishi, ushiye izimbobo. Iminenke ithanda ubumanzi, ngakho iyanda emva kwemvula.

UKhwezilomso ubona namabhungane amnyama. Ibhungane lihamba kancane phezu kweklabishi, lilidle. UMkhulu Msweli uthi: "Iminenke namabhungane kuzoqeda amaklabishi ami! Angifuni ukusebenzisa ubuthi, ngoba ubuthi bubulala nezinyoni."

UKhwezilomso uthi: "Mkhulu, umakhelwane wethu unamahansi. Uthi amahansi adla iminenke namabhungane." UMkhulu Msweli uyavuma. NgoMgqibelo bayaya epulazini eliseduze, bathenge ihansi elimhlophe namachwane alo amane. Amachwane amancane, ampunga, futhi ahamba ngemuva kwehansi.

Ihansi lingena esivandeni, lifune iminenke. Lithola umnenke, liwudle. Lithola nebhungane, lilidle. Amachwane ayalandela, nawo adla amabhungane amancane. Ngemuva kwesonto iminenke isimbalwa kakhulu.

Ngelinye ilanga uKhwezilomso udlala ngebhola lakhe elisha egcekeni. Ibhola liwa esivandeni. Ihansi liyeza, libheke ibhola. Bese liliqhumbuza ngomlomo walo! Ibhola liyaqhumbuzeka, umoya uphume kulo. UKhwezilomso uyakhala kancane, kodwa uMkhulu Msweli uyahleka. Uthi: "Leli hansi liqhumbuza ibhola lakho, kodwa lidla iminenke. Ngizokuthengela elinye ibhola." UKhwezilomso uthi: "Kulungile, Mkhulu. Kodwa ngizodlala kude nehansi!"

Esivandeni kukhona nechibi elincane. Ebusuku amaxoxo aphuma echibini. Ixoxo ngalinye lidla izimpukane nezinye izilwane ezincane. UKhwezilomso ulalela amaxoxo ebusuku. Uthi: "Amaxoxo nawo ayasisiza."

Ngemuva kwenyanga amaklabishi kaMkhulu Msweli makhulu futhi. Ihansi namachwane alo ahlala egcekeni, futhi amaxoxo ahlala echibini. Iminenke ayisekho.

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani emhlabathini ngemuva kwemvula?
Umhlabathi ugcwele ubumanzi.
Yini edla amaklabishi kaMkhulu Msweli?
Iminenke namabhungane kudla amaklabishi.
Kungani uMkhulu Msweli engafuni ukusebenzisa ubuthi?
Ngoba ubuthi bubulala nezinyoni.
UMkhulu Msweli noKhwezilomso bathengani epulazini?
Bathenga ihansi elimhlophe namachwane alo amane.
Ihansi lenzani ebholeni likaKhwezilomso?
Liqhumbuza ibhola ngomlomo walo.
Amaxoxo enzani ebusuku?
Aphuma echibini, adle izimpukane.

lessons.title: Ukucwila echibini
lessons.summary: On a hot day in Ntambanana, herd boys Mfundiso and Bhekuyise leave the cattle by a big pool with a whip and a parrying stick on the grass and hold a diving contest; Bhekuyise dives too deep, water goes down his windpipe and Mfundiso pulls him out and hits his back until he coughs it up; old Gogo Mntambo beckons them to her house, wipes his face with a sponge, makes small cuts on his chest to rub in medicine as the old healers do, and tells them never to dive alone.
lessons.text:
UMfundiso noBhekuyise bangabafana abelusa izinkomo eNtambanana. Njalo ekuseni bakhipha izinkomo zomndeni esibayeni, bazise otshanini eduze nechibi elikhulu. UMfundiso uphethe isiswebhu. Uma inkomo ihamba kude, uyayishaya kancane ngesiswebhu, ibuye. UBhekuyise uphethe induku nobhoko. Ubhoko luyinduku yokuzivikela uma umuntu ekushaya ngenduku. Abafana bakhona bafunda ukulwa ngezinduku nangobhoko.

NgoLwesithathu kushisa kakhulu. Izinkomo ziphuza amanzi echibini, bese zilala emthunzini. Abafana babeka isiswebhu nobhoko otshanini. UBhekuyise uthi: "Ake sincintisane ngokucwila! Ngubani ongahlala ngaphansi kwamanzi isikhathi eside?" UMfundiso uthi: "Kulungile. Kodwa ukucwila kunzima. Masihlale lapho amanzi engajulile khona."

UMfundiso ucwila kuqala. Uhlala ngaphansi kwamanzi isikhathi esincane, bese ephuma. Bese uBhekuyise ecwila. Ufuna ukunqoba, ngakho uhamba aye phakathi kwechibi, lapho amanzi ejule kakhulu. Ucwila isikhathi eside kakhulu. Lapho ephuma, uvula umlomo ngaphambi kokuthi ikhanda lakhe liphume emanzini. Amanzi angena emlonyeni wakhe, ehle ngoqhoqhoqho.

UBhekuyise uyakhwehlela, kodwa akakwazi ukuphefumula. Uqhoqhoqho wakhe ugcwele amanzi. Ushaya amanzi ngezandla. UMfundiso ubona ukuthi kukhona inkinga. Ubhukuda ngokushesha aye kuBhekuyise, amdonse aye ogwini. Ogwini uMfundiso ushaya uBhekuyise emhlane ngesandla, amshaye futhi. Ekugcineni uBhekuyise ukhwehlela amanzi aphume kuqhoqhoqho wakhe. Uyaphefumula futhi.

UGogo Mntambo uhlala endlini eseduze nechibi. Uyinyanga endala yendawo. Ubonile konke. Umi emnyango, abaqhwebe ngesandla. Abafana bayabona ukuthi uyabaqhweba. UMfundiso uthatha isiswebhu nobhoko otshanini, bese behamba kuye.

Endlini uGogo Mntambo uthatha isiponji, asifake emanzini afudumele. Usula ubuso bukaBhekuyise ngesiponji, asule nesifuba sakhe. Bese ethatha ummese omncane. Uthi: "Ngizokugcaba kancane, njengoba abelaphi bakudala babenza." Ugcaba isifuba sakhe kathathu, enze izilonda ezincane kakhulu, bese ehlikihla umuthi ezilondeni. UBhekuyise akakhali. Uthi: "Akubuhlungu kakhulu, Gogo." Ugogo uthi: "Lo muthi uzokuqinisa. Kodwa ningaphindi nicwile ningekho nomuntu omdala. Ukucwila kuyingozi lapho amanzi ejulile."

Kusihlwa abafana babuyisa izinkomo esibayeni. UMfundiso uphethe isiswebhu, uBhekuyise uphethe ubhoko lwakhe. UBhekuyise uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Mfundiso. Wangisindisa namuhla." UMfundiso uthi: "Kusukela namuhla sizocwila lapho amanzi engajulile khona kuphela."

Imibuzo:
UMfundiso wenzani ngesiswebhu?
Uma inkomo ihamba kude, uyayishaya kancane ngesiswebhu.
Ubhoko luyini?
Luyinduku yokuzivikela uma umuntu ekushaya ngenduku.
Kungani uBhekuyise ehamba phakathi kwechibi?
Ngoba ufuna ukunqoba emncintiswaneni wokucwila.
Kwenzekani lapho uBhekuyise evula umlomo?
Amanzi angena emlonyeni wakhe, ehle ngoqhoqhoqho.
UMfundiso usiza uBhekuyise kanjani?
Umdonsa aye ogwini, bese emshaya emhlane.
UGogo Mntambo wenzani ngesiponji?
Usula ubuso nesifuba sikaBhekuyise ngesiponji.
